profile_text.body:
Appian Corp is a public company headquartered in McLean, Virginia, traded under the ticker APPN, that describes itself as providing AI-powered process orchestration across the enterprise. On its own site the company says it has been automating processes for more than 25 years and that customers use its platform to build AI-powered processes that accelerate work, reduce cost, and manage risk. It says its platform is intended to orchestrate AI agents, systems, and people from a single place, to give AI reliability and control, and to modernize legacy applications with AI.

The site presents Appian's automation work across a range of business functions, including accounts payable and receivable, invoice processing and reconciliation, sourcing and supplier management, purchasing and procure-to-pay, audit and compliance, case management, onboarding, order intake and fulfillment, and contract review and approvals. It also describes no-code app building with embedded AI agents that extract data, act autonomously, and generate code from natural language prompts. Appian states that it was named a Leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies (BOAT), points to a Gartner assessment of 20 BOAT vendors, and cites an AI Value Study with Harvard Business Review Analytic Services. One claim on the site says AI automation cuts onboarding time by up to 50%.

Records held for the company list 145 cases in Virginia. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are otherwise recorded for it.
